1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 30 cm de longitud, de cuerpo corto, oblongo, moderadamente comprimido, de color plateado parduzco con puntos negros, cabeza baja, hocico cónico y ojos grandes. Sciaenidae, Odontoscion dentex.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish, up to 30 cm in length, with a short, oblong body that is moderately compressed, having a silvery-brown color with black spots, a low head, conical snout, and large eyes. Sciaenidae, Odontoscion dentex.
